newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Catalina Marketing FY Q1 EPS down.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Catalina Marketing FY Q1 EPS down.

text.p: NOTE: -- Net income for the quarter included pre-tax losses from the company's domestic new business ventures of $1.6 million, or $0.05 cents per share after tax. In the comparable quarter a year ago, such losses totaled $2.9 million, or $0.08 cents per share after tax.

-- Co says net income for quarter lower due to factors including: aggressive development of new products, the expansion of sales and service groups in the company's core business, increased depreciation expense resulting from network expansion and investment in facilities and information systems capacity, higher losses in the company's international operations, and increased interest expense due to the company's share repurchase activity.

-- Co repurchased 1.4 million shares (7 percent) of its common stock at a weighted price of $28.50 each. The company borrowed $22 million for the purchase and has since paid back $10.5 million by end Q2.
